title: Hover and focus
text: Shows on pointer hover and keyboard focus, and hides on Escape.

title: Label or description
text: Describes its trigger, or names an icon-only control as its label.

title: Tunable delays
text: Show and hide delays keep tooltips from flickering while the pointer moves.

title: Smart placement
text: Prefers a side you choose and flips to stay inside the viewport.
